integrity.computational_scope: Exhaustive n=2..8; further exact checks through n=35; finite tests not a proof of infinite assertions
integrity.reproducibility: Self-contained proof in RESULT.md, finite exact verification in verify.py; source inspections and limitations recorded in AUDIT.json

scientific_limitations: The covariance and local positivity hold for all integers n>=2 and 2<=k<=n, but the asymptotic law is restricted to fixed k; only a size-biased mean shift is proved, not stochastic domination. The complete text of the 1981 Lifschitz–Pittel source could not be inspected, leaving historical-priority uncertainty.
title: A rank-dispersion law for fixed points under increasing-subsequence size bias
